title: BehaviorGPT: Smart Agent Simulation for Autonomous Driving with Next-Patch Prediction

control_signal.value: None. The model is conditioned only on the vector map and initial agent states; the authors say prompts such as language or goal points are not supported.

control_mechanism.value: No control mechanism; the paper states the model does not support controlling behaviour with prompts such as language or goal points.

base_model.value: Decoder-only autoregressive Transformer with next-patch prediction; triple attention (temporal self, agent-map cross, agent-agent); mixture-distribution head with 16 modes; 3M parameters.

datasets.value: Waymo Open Motion Dataset: 486,995 / 44,097 / 44,920 train/val/test scenarios, 91 steps at 10 Hz; evaluated on Waymo Open Sim Agents benchmark.

metrics.value: minADE and REALISM meta-metric with kinematics, object distance, collision, TTC, road-edge distance and offroad sub-metrics (WOSAC).

controllability_evidence.value: None; no controllability experiment. Realism result reported instead: REALISM 0.7473, minADE 1.4147 on the 2024 Waymo Sim Agents test set.

stated_limitations.value: Weaker kinematics realism (could add a bicycle model); no control via language or goal points; compounding errors can cause offroad rollouts; benefit for motion planning not verified.

notes: Pure realism-focused agent simulator; not about controllable generation. Authors only claim adding control 'should be trivial', which is unsupported in the packet.
